name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 7 visits over 67 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.8 days starting 2025-07-11, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
